effect_description_eng:
＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] For every 4 cards your opponent's hand has, trash any 2 digivolution cards from their Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't suspend until their turn ends.
